name: Malmesbury Praise (titles; public-domain ones with words)
note: Numbers 1–48 with titles. Words included only for public-domain hymns; add the others under your church's licence.

v: I was sinking deep in sin far from the peaceful shore,
Very deeply stained within sinking to rise no more,
But the Master of the sea heard my despairing cry,
From the waters lifted me, now safe am I.
Souls in danger look above Jesus completely saves,
He will lift you by His love out of the angry waves,
He's the Master of the sea billows His will obey,
He your Savior wants to be, be saved today.
c: Love lifted me, love lifted me,

hymns.t: This World Is Not My Home

v: Just as I am without one plea
But that Thy blood was shed for me
And that Thou bid'st me come to Thee
O Lamb of God I come, I come.
Just as I am Thy love I own
Has broken every barrier down
Now to be Thine and Thine alone
O Lamb of God I come, I come.

hymns.t: His Eye Is on the Sparrow
v: Why should I feel discouraged?
Why should the shadows come?
Why should my heart be lonely and long for heaven and home?
When Jesus is my portion
My constant friend is He,
His eye is on the sparrow and I know He watches me.
Let not your heart be troubled
His tender words I hear
And resting on His goodness I lose my doubts and fears
Though by the path He leadeth
But one step I may see
His eye is on the sparrow and I know He watches me.
c: For His eye is on the sparrow and I know He watches me.

hymns.t: When We All Get to Heaven
v: Sing the wondrous love of Jesus
Sing His mercy and His grace
In the mansions bright and blessed
He'll prepare for us a place.
Onward to the prize before us
Soon His beauty we'll behold
Soon the pearly gates will open
We shall tread the streets of gold.
c: When we all get to heaven
What a day of rejoicing that will be
We'll sing and shout the victory.

v: Amazing grace how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost but now am found
Was blind but now I see
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed
Thru' many dangers toils and snares
I have already come
'Tis grace has brought me safe thus far
And grace will lead me home.

hymns.t: I Need the Prayers of Those I Love
I Will Be Still, Know You Are God
I Will Never Be the Same Again
My Life Is in Your Hands
Sitting at the Feet of Jesus
Thank You Lord, for Your Blessings on Me
Little Is Much When God Is in It

licence: Public-domain songs include their words; for the others add the words under your church's own licence.
